name: escalate_to_human
description: Hand the conversation to a human pharmacist/agent. ALWAYS use this for: any request for dosage, diagnosis or medical advice; scheduled/controlled medicines; a customer who asks for a pharmacist; low confidence in the right action; abusive input; or anything the contract cannot serve. This is a terminal action for the turn.

summary.description: One line for the human: what the customer wants and why it was escalated.

returns.description: handover_id, acknowledgement text to send to the customer.
